description: Creates the monitors the user chose from preview_monitor_import (send their `monitor` objects). Each takes a plan slot like create_monitor; ones already monitored are skipped. Imported heartbeats get new URLs, returned once as heartbeat_url: tell the user to point their scheduled jobs at them. Needs a write token. Free.

monitors.description: The `monitor` objects of the preview's items to create, unchanged or edited (name, interval_seconds, status). Each takes a plan slot as a single new monitor would; one already monitored is skipped.

source.description: The preview's source, recorded in the audit log.

name: import_monitors
title: Import monitors
